in_sanskrit.name: Mahadu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Majestic, Great
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahadu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mahadu is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'great', 'majestic'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'maha' meaning 'great' and 'du' meaning 'two'. This name is often given to boys who are expected to lead and inspire others with their strength and courage.
